description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers technical solutions to complex national security challenges for government customers. The entry-level software engineer will develop and enhance desktop, backend, and web-based modeling and data analysis tools, while analyzing requirements, testing software, and documenting products.
Software engineer building and testing desktop, backend, and web applications with customer-support utilities

Responsibilities:
• Designing, developing, and improving desktop, server backend, and web-based software, including specialized utilities to support our customers
• Analyzing and quantifying requirements; applying computer science, engineering, and mathematical principles to build solutions; updating and enhancing existing software
• Thoroughly testing and documenting software products

Requirements:
• Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field
• Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming, including design patterns, polymorphism, data structures, and algorithms
• Experience in software development and database design and maintenance
• Excellent analytical skills
• Proven ability to communicate effectively, both in written and verbal formats, with diverse stakeholders
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Top Secret clearance with SCI access

Preferred:
• Experience with any of the following is also useful: Web Services, SQL Databases, XML, C++/C#, Rust, Python, React
• Services oriented architecture experience
